definitions.gloss: close by; nearby; at close range
definitions.explanation: Physically very close; within a short distance. Describes being near enough to see or experience something in detail.

definitions.gloss: imminent; approaching; just around the corner
definitions.explanation: Temporally very close; about to happen. Used for events, deadlines, or occasions that are drawing near.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間近|まぢか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw Mt. Fuji up close.

examples.japanese: {間近|まぢか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{迫力|はくりょく}→迫力：14310_hakuryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It's impressive when you see it up close.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間近|まぢか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧{特等席|とくとうせき}だった。
examples.english: It was a prime seat where you could see the fireworks up close.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{間近|まぢか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迫|せま}っている→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間近|まぢか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{控|ひか}えた→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧たち。
examples.english: Students with graduation just around the corner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{間近|まぢか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迫|せま}り→迫る：03928_semaru⟧、⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{忙|いそが}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ま}している→増す：02422_masu⟧。
examples.english: With completion imminent, the worksite is getting busier.

notes:
Compound of {間|ま} (space/interval) + {近|ちか} (near). The ぢ in まぢか reflects historical kana orthography (ち → ぢ in compounds).

SENSE 1 (spatial):
Used with で or ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mean "at close range" or "up close."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (sense 1):
- {間近|まぢか}で⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see up close)
- {間近|まぢか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧ (to approach closely)

SENSE 2 (temporal):
Used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mean "imminent" or "approaching."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (sense 2):
- {間近|まぢか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧ (to be imminent)
- {間近|まぢか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧ (to have something approaching)
